gloss: being well-versed; expert knowledge; thorough familiarity

definitions.gloss: being well-versed in; having expert knowledge of; thorough familiarity
definitions.explanation: Having deep, detailed knowledge of a particular subject or field. Used with する to indicate mastering or being thoroughly familiar with something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{法律|ほうりつ}に{精通|せいつう}している。
この{分野|ぶんや}に{精通|せいつう}した{専門家|せんもんか}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need an expert well-versed in this field.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{事情|じじょう}に{精通|せいつう}している{人|ひと}に{案内|あんない}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked someone familiar with local affairs to show me around.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Used as a suru verb. The pattern is ～に{精通|せいつう}する (to be well-versed in ~). The particle に marks the field or subject of expertise.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～に{精通|せいつう}している (is well-versed in ~)
- ～に{精通|せいつう}した + noun (noun well-versed in ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法律|ほうりつ}に{精通|せいつう}する (to be well-versed in law)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}に{精通|せいつう}する (to be well-versed in technology)
- {業界|ぎょうかい}に{精通|せいつう}する (to be well-versed in the industry)

NUANCE:
Implies deeper, more specialized knowledge than {詳|くわ}しい (knowledgeable). {精通|せいつう} suggests professional-level or expert familiarity.
